sloka: प्रत्यक्षं वानरेन्द्रस्य तद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम् ।त्वया सन्त्यक्तया वीर त्यक्तं स्याज्जीवितं मया ।। ६.११९.१२ ।।
transliteration: pratyakṣaṁ vānarendrasya tadvākyasamanantaram ।tvayā santyaktayā vīra tyaktaṁ syājjīvitaṁ mayā ।। 6.119.12 ।।

translations.english: "O hero! Had you given me up immediately on receiving your message from Vanara I would have given up my life in the presence of Hanuman there itself."
